title: Exam schedule
scenario: A student asks for the date or timetable of an examination.
content: For A student asks for the date or timetable of an examination., identify the student's examination category, class or program, subject, course, and relevant session before answering. Academic schedules, syllabi, results, answer keys, and exam rules are version-sensitive. Use the latest approved academic source and never substitute an older schedule or a different examination category. If the internal KB does not contain the requested current information, the workflow may use an approved public source when policy permits it. Disputed questions and answer keys should be routed to academic review when the available evidence does not establish the answer. Do not fabricate dates, marks, eligibility, or official exam decisions.
